name: capella
description: Open-source editor interface for opencode 1.x and 2.x (Zen and Go): chat, approvals, diffs, usage and web access inside VS Code and its forks.

author.name: Antonio Rafael Souza Cruz de Noronha

viewsWelcome.contents:
Capella, an editor interface for opencode (Zen and Go).

[Open Capella](command:capella.open)

[Show Zen/Go usage](command:capella.showUsage)

[Set up local voice](command:capella.setupVoice)

[Compatibility diagnostics](command:capella.diagnostics)

capella.opencodePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `opencode` executable. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH, then common install locations). This setting can only be changed in your user settings, not by a folder you open, because it decides which program Capella starts.

capella.updates.check.markdownDescription: Periodically compare the installed opencode version with the latest published one and warn when it is newer than the version Capella was tested with. Only the version number is requested; nothing about you or your project is sent. Capella never updates opencode by itself.

capella.usage.alerts.markdownDescription: Warn when the OpenCode Go 5-hour, weekly or monthly allowance reaches one of the thresholds below.

capella.usage.alertThresholds.markdownDescription: Percentages that raise an alert for each window. Each fires once per window and re-arms when usage falls back below it.

capella.usage.statusBar.markdownDescription: Show the Go allowance in the status bar once Capella has been used in this window.

enumDescriptions: Use faster-whisper when it is set up, else Windows speech recognition when Windows has a recognizer for it.
Local Whisper on your CPU (more accurate; one-time setup of about 450 MB).
The speech recognition built into Windows (offline, nothing to install, lower quality; Windows needs a desktop speech recognizer installed, which not every PC has).
capella.voice.engine.markdownDescription: Which engine turns your voice into text. Audio never leaves your computer with either engine.

capella.voice.language.markdownDescription: Spoken language: `auto` (Whisper detects it; Windows speech uses the editor language), a code such as `pt` or `en`, or a locale such as `pt-BR`.

enumDescriptions: About 75 MB. Fastest, makes more mistakes.
About 145 MB. A good balance on a CPU.
About 465 MB. More accurate, slower, needs more memory.
capella.voice.model.markdownDescription: Whisper model for faster-whisper. Changing it needs `Capella: Set up local voice` to download the new model.

capella.voice.home.markdownDescription: Folder where local voice (the private Python environment and the model, about 450 MB) is installed. Empty uses the standard per-user location. Set by `Capella: Set up local voice` when you choose a folder. This setting can only be changed in your user settings, not by a folder you open, because it decides which program Capella starts.

capella.voice.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python 3.9+ used to create the private environment. Empty looks for `py -3`, `python` and `python3`. This setting can only be changed in your user settings, not by a folder you open, because it decides which program Capella starts.

capella.voice.maxSeconds.markdownDescription: Longest single dictation, in seconds. Recording stops by itself at this length.

capella.voice.idleMinutes.markdownDescription: The Whisper worker is stopped after this many idle minutes to give its memory back.

capella.dev.voice.markdownDescription: Development only: fake recorder and transcriber (no microphone, no engine).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Capella runs opencode, an agent that reads files and can run commands in the open folder, so it stays off until you trust the folder.
